title: Meet Fox's Latest Favorite Primetime Guest: John Fetterman

content:

# **Fox 's Fetterman Obsession**

John Fetterman appears with host Jesse Watters on 'Jesse Watters Primetime '
on Nov. 3, 2025. Photo by Shannon Finney/Getty Images_

In the run-up to the 2022 midterms and with control of the Senate hanging in
the balance, Fox's primetime lineup [went all-
in](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-prime-time-goes-all-against-
john-fetterman) against the opponent of **Sean Hannity 's** hand-picked GOP
candidate in Pennsylvania,[ portraying the Democratic
challenger](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/fox-news-repugnant-smears-
about-john-fettermans-stroke) as a "giant walking vegetable" who "can barely
utter a sentence."

Besides [peppering its airwaves with
smears](https://www.mediamatters.org/sean-hannity/sean-hannity-says-john-
fettermans-stroke-was-crippling-him) about **John Fetterman 's** then-recent
stroke leaving him an ["incompetent
husk,"](https://www.mediamatters.org/tucker-carlson/tucker-carlson-says-john-
fettermans-stroke-has-left-him-incapable-representing) the network's right-
wing stars also fearmongered about the Senate hopeful's policies, labeling him
as ["pro-murderer"](https://www.mediamatters.org/sean-hannity/foxs-sean-
hannity-claims-john-fetterman-single-most-pro-murderer-candidate-america) and
suggesting he wanted to ["legalize all
drugs."](https://www.mediamatters.org/fox-news/right-wing-media-boost-lie-
john-fetterman-wants-legalize-all-drugs)

Flash forward to the present, and the same person who Hannity and the rest of
the Fox crew obsessively warned its viewers about has now become one of the
MAGA network's favorite guests.
